one_liner: Mental health app for meditation, sleep, coaching and therapy
niche: meditation, sleep and mental health app
audience: Stressed adults roughly 22-45 juggling work, sleep problems and everyday anxiety, plus parents wanting calmer bedtimes and employees whose employer or health plan covers mental health support (inferred age range)

a free breathing exercise on your phone's health app
